actions.reason: The K5_C0001–K5_C0005 boundary is weak and materially cross-modally discordant: WSI expresses the boundary (silhouette 0.393) while CT (0.029), RNA (0.040), and WXS (0.023) show near-zero silhouette with within- and between-label distances nearly equal. Structurally the current boundary is poorly reproduced (spectral ARI 0.044), normalized-cut cost is high (0.904) indicating substantial cross-boundary connectivity, and the union is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.733), which is merge-compatible. The K5_C0005 side is very small in graph volume (38.3 vs 499.3), so the current two-unit representation is weakly supported. This coherent weak-boundary plus single-cluster-dominated-union pattern supports a provisional merge for re-review.

Membership representation is weak (set-scope silhouettes -0.070 to 0.092), but independence is affirmatively supported by pair boundaries: the K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005–K5_C0004 boundary has perfect spectral ARI (1.0) with within-affinity 0.398 vs between 0.108, and the K5_C0001_M_K5_C0005–K5_C0003 boundary has ARI 0.792 with within 0.399 vs between 0.111. Internal subdivision is not supported (screen_candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.733; higher-k native projections near zero/negative). No supported split or merge rescue remains.
